chapter.verse: Tua lai takin a kikhawm mi khempeuhte ding-in Zeisu Pilat mangpa kiangah a paipih uh hi.
“Hih pa in komau pawlte kheem a, ‘Khazih kici kumpipa ka hi hi. Kaisar kumpipa phiangsiah pia kei un,’ ci-in a kham kote’n ka za uh hi,” ci-in Zeisu a mawhsak uh hi.
Pilat in, “Nang Judah Kumpipa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, Zeisu in, “Na cih mah bangin ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Pilat in, “Hih pa tungah mawhna ka mu kei hi,” ci-in siampi liante leh mihonpite kiangah a gen hi.
Amaute kiko semsemin, “Amah in Galile gam pan akipan hih lai gam dongin, Judah gam sung khempeuh ah thu hilhin mi a zol hi,” a ci uh hi.
Pilat in hih thu a zak ciangin, “Hih mi in Galile mi ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu Herod’ uksung mi ahih lam a theih ciangin, Herod kiangah a paisak hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua lai takin Herod Jerusalem khuapi-ah a om hi.
Herod in Zeisu a muh ciangin nakpi-in a lungdam hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Zeisu thu za ngei ahih maninah a muh nopna sauvei zoin, Zeisu’ nalamdang bawl a mu nuam hi.
Amah in thu tampi a dot hangin, Zeisu in kam khat beek a dawng kik kei hi.
Tua lai takin siampi liante leh laitheite ding-in nakpi-in a mawhsak uh hi.
Herod in a galkapte tawh Zeisu simmawhin a zahko uh a, puan hoih a silhsak khit uh ciangin, Pilat kiangah a paisak kik uh hi.
Tua ni-in Pilat leh Herod te, khat leh khat a kilem kik uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, nidangin a kiho thei kei uh hi.
Pilat in siampi liante, upate leh mite sam a,
“Mite a kheem thei mi bangin hih mipa kei kiangah nong paipih uh hi. Note mai-ah amah ka dot hanginah, na mawhsakna uh bangin mawhna khat beek ama tungah ka mu kei hi.
Herod in zong a mu kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Herod in kei kiangah hong puak kik zo hi.
Hih mi in sihna thuak nading a kilawm bangmah a hih kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, ka sat khit ciangin ka khah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in, “Tua pa that in la, ko kiangah Barabbas hong khah in,” ci-in aw khatin a kiko uh hi.
Tua Barabbas in khua sungah misuam a, mi a thah manin thong sungah a kikhum hi.
Pilat in Zeisu khah nuamin amaute kiangah thu a gen kik hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, “Tua pa singlamteh tungah that in, singlamteh tungah that in,” ci-in a kiko uh hi.

Pilat in, “Bang hang hiam? Amah in mawhna bang ta khial ahi hiam? Ama sih nadingin a kilawm ama tungah thu khat beek ka mu kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka sat khit ciangin ka khah ding hi,” ci-a thumveina a gen hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Zeisu singlamteh tungah thah nading nakpi takin a kiko uh hi.
Amaute aw in zo a; Pilat in amaute’ ngetna bang a piang dingin thu a khen hi.
Mi suam a, mi a thah maninah thong sungah a kikhumpa amaute’ ngetna bangin khah a, amau ut bangin a bawl dingun Zeisu a pia hi.
Amaute in Zeisu a paipih lai takun, gampa lak panin hong pai Simon kici Sairin mi khat, Zeisu nung lamah singlamteh pua dingin a tungah a suan uh hi.
Mi tampi leh Zeisu hangin nakpi a thuum numei tampite in a nung a zui uh hi.
Zeisu in kihei a, “Jerusalem’ tanute aw, kei adingin kap kei un. No ading leh na tate uh ading na kap zaw un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ‘Tasel numei leh ta a paii ngeilo gil leh a kine ngeilo nawite in thupha a ngah ding uh hi,’ a cih ding uh hun hong tung ding hi.
Tua lai takin mite in, ‘Komau tungah hong kia un. Komau hong vuk un,’ ci-in mualte a sam ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sing hing tungah a hici bawl uh leh, sing keu tungah bangci bawl ding ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu tawh migilo, mi that ahi adang mi nih thah dingin a paipih khawm uh hi.
‘Lutang Guh’ kici mun a tun’ uh ciangin, Zeisu tawh migilo nih a ziatlam khat, a veilam khat singlamteh tungah a khaikhawm uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pa aw, amau in bang ahih uh cih thei lo ahih uh ciangin amau mawhna na maisak in,” a ci hi. Amau in lai aisaan-in a puante a hawm uh hi.
Mite in enin a ding uh hi. A ukte in, “Hih pa in midangte a gum thei hi. Pasian’ teelsa Khazih ahih takpi leh, ama pumpi kigum ta hen,” ci-in a zahko uh hi.
Galkapte zong pai uh a, tuithuk pia-in,
“Nang Judah Kumpipa na hih takpi leh, na pumpi kigum in,” ci-in a zahko uh hi.
“HIHPA IN JUDAHTE’ KUMPIPA HI,” ci-in kigelhna lai a tungah a om hi.
Tua lai takin a kikhai migilote khat in, “Nang Khazih hilo na hi hiam? Nang leh ko hong gum in,” ci-in Zeisu a zahko hi.
Khat in ahih leh, “Nangmah in hih pa mah bangin mawhna thu tanna na thuak napi-in, Pasian kihta lo na hi hiam?
Eite in thuman thu tanna i thuak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, eite’ hihna tawh kituak i thuak hi. Hih pa ahih leh, bangmah mawhna a bawl kei hi,” ci-in a lawmpa a taai hi.
Zeisu kiangah, “Topa aw, na Gam sungah na lut khit ciangin kei hong ngaihsun in,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, tuni-in nangmah in kei tawh Paradis ah na omkhawm ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin sun nai sawm-le-nih lai tak ahi hi. Nai thum dongin nitaang a bei maninah, leitung khempeuh ah khua a mial hi.
Biakna innpi dalna puan a lai zang pan a kikeek hi.
Zeisu in, “Ka Pa aw, ka kha nangma khut tungah ka pia hi,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko khit ciangin a si hi.
Galkap mangpa in tua thu piangte a muh ciangin, “Hih pa in mi diktat mi ahi hi,” ci-in Pasian’ min a phat hi.
Tua thu en dinga hong pai mihonpi khempeuhte in, tua thu piangte a muh uh ciangin awm beengin a ciah uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu a thei mi khempeuhte leh Galile gam pan hong zui numeite in zong gamlapi panin tuate a gal-et uh hi.
Tua lai takin Judah gam Arimathea khua mi Josef kici, upa vaihawmte laka khat in upa dangte’ deihna leh gamtatna zui loin, Pasian’ Gam lamenin, a diktat mipha khat ahi hi.
Tua pa Pilat kiangah pai a, Zeisu’ luang a ngen hi.
Amah in Zeisu’ luang lasukin saihadial puan tawh a tun khit ciangin, mi kivui ngei lohna suang kikhuak han sungah a sial hi.
Tua ni in Kigin ni hi a, Nipi ni a nai hi.
Galile gam pan Zeisu tawh hong pai numeite in zui uh a, han leh a luang bangci koih ahi hiam ci-in a en uh hi.
Amaute ciah uh a, paknamtui leh sathau namtui a bawl uh hi. Thukham bangin Nipi ni-in nasem loin a om uh hi.
